summary.text: Jeff Vernetti is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 123 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A business owner and real estate developer at the Lake of the Ozarks, he serves on the Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Vernetti was born in St. Louis, Missouri, graduated from Lafayette High School in 1995, and earned a bachelor's degree in mass communications from Southeast Missouri State University in 1999.
His career experience includes being a local business owner and real estate developer.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Vernetti described himself as a husband, father and local real estate developer at the Lake of the Ozarks.
Vernetti took office on January 8, 2025, and for the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the Budget Committee and the House Economic Development Committee.

In the same survey, he listed his key campaign messages as investing in infrastructure, supporting tourism and the Lake of the Ozarks economy and development, and protecting and promoting agriculture interests in the district.
